### SQL Used

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x26e68.x1_retention AS
WITH cohorts AS (
  SELECT
    trunc(signup_date, 'WEEK') AS cohort_week,
    count(distinct user_id) AS cohort_size
  FROM workspace.exam_x26e68.signups
  GROUP BY trunc(signup_date, 'WEEK')
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT explode(sequence(0, 4)) AS week_n
),
cohort_grid AS (
  SELECT
    c.cohort_week,
    c.cohort_size,
    w.week_n
  FROM cohorts c
  CROSS JOIN weeks w
),
user_activity AS (
  SELECT
    s.user_id,
    trunc(s.signup_date, 'WEEK') AS cohort_week,
    floor(datediff(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7) AS week_n
  FROM workspace.exam_x26e68.signups s
  JOIN workspace.exam_x26e68.activity a
    ON s.user_id = a.user_id
   AND a.activity_date >= s.signup_date
  WHERE floor(datediff(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7) BETWEEN 0 AND 4
),
active_by_cohort_week AS (
  SELECT
    cohort_week,
    week_n,
    count(distinct user_id) AS active_users
  FROM user_activity
  GROUP BY cohort_week, week_n
)
SELECT
  cg.cohort_week,
  cg.cohort_size,
  cg.week_n,
  coalesce(a.active_users, 0) AS active_users,
  round(100.0 * coalesce(a.active_users, 0) / cg.cohort_size, 1) AS retention_pct
FROM cohort_grid cg
LEFT JOIN active_by_cohort_week a
  ON cg.cohort_week = a.cohort_week
 AND cg.week_n = a.week_n
ORDER BY cg.cohort_week, cg.week_n;
```
